title: meta-analysis.cz: harmonised estimate-level data from meta-analyses in economics
description:
What this deposit contains. The harmonised estimate-level table pooling 39 economics meta-analysis literatures, the machine-readable dataset index, a column-level codebook for each of the 44 source datasets, and the documentation. It does NOT contain the per-dataset format conversions, the papers themselves, or their replication packages; those remain at https://meta-analysis.cz.

Licence scope. The CC BY 4.0 licence on this record covers the COMPILATION only: the dataset index, the codebooks, the harmonisation mappings and the documentation. It does not cover the underlying research datasets, their CSV/Parquet format conversions, or the papers' own replication code. Those were assembled by author teams that mostly extend beyond this deposit's authors, and their rights are unchanged by it. Each dataset carries a rights_status in datasets.json; where that reads unspecified, no open licence has been established and the data should be treated as all rights reserved unless the paper or its publisher says otherwise. Attribution is not the same as permission. Full terms: https://meta-analysis.cz/LICENSE

Estimate-level data from meta-analyses in economics and the social sciences, with the study and design characteristics hand-coded for each original paper.

What the numbers mean. 44 datasets contain 65,349 rows in the converted source files. After each paper's own analysis selection, and where necessary a reshape of wide data into estimate-level form, those become 61,294 estimates. The harmonised table pools 54,076 of them across 39 literatures. Each dataset also ships a column-level codebook.

The harmonised table holds one row per harmonised observation, not always per independent estimate: price_puzzle reshapes wide impulse-response columns into one row per horizon, and house_prices contributes about seven horizons per response. Check the horizon column before treating rows as independent.

Review status. 19 of the 39 pooled literatures are verified against the paper's own replication code, with the evidence quoted per dataset; the other 20 rest on an arithmetic effect/standard-error pairing and are provisional. Every dataset publishes an audit_status. This is a beta release.

Which column holds the effect and which its standard error was resolved arithmetically rather than by name: the correct pair is the one for which the effect divided by its standard error reproduces the t-statistic the dataset already reports. Where that was not decisive, the mapping was taken from the paper's own published replication code, and the evidence is recorded per dataset.

Every row of the harmonised table carries the source file and the exact column names it came from, so any value can be traced back to the published dataset and checked. Effects are not comparable across literatures in raw units; an effect_units column records what each one measures.

The harmonised table is a beta release and may be revised.
notes: CC BY 4.0 applies to the compilation (index, codebooks, harmonisation mappings, documentation) and to newly written software under MIT. It does not relicense the underlying research datasets, their format conversions, or the papers' replication code. Cite both the collection and the individual paper whose data you use.
